description: IT5005 technical report (PDF) evaluating cloud backup options for a 25-person accounting firm, with a brief but no rubric. Tests BRIEF_ONLY mode (no numerical marking), PDF extraction, WRITTEN_WORK specialist review, and requirement-level detection of missing sections. The report is about 1,470 words excluding tables and references (within 1,500 ±10%), has a cost table and IEEE numeric citations [1]-[5] matching a reference list. Deliberate defects: (1) there is no risks and mitigation section at all; (2) only Option A is analysed in depth - Option B (consumer cloud storage) is dismissed in one sentence in section 3.2 without evaluation, so the requirement to compare at least two options is not met (Option B only appears in the cost table).
report_must_contain: NO AUTHORISED NUMERICAL MARKING SCHEME WAS PROVIDED.
REFERENCE AUTHENTICITY WAS NOT EXTERNALLY VERIFIED.
